quotes.text:
TOTUS1
How many hours per week do you usually work in your (main)
job/business – please exclude meal breaks?

ACTHR
Thinking now about the seven days ending Sunday the …, how many
hours did you actually work in your (main) job/business – please
exclude meal breaks and overtime?

assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument records hours of paid work in questions such as TOTUS1 and ACTHR under the 'HOURS WORKED (MAIN JOB)' section. However, an examination of the entire questionnaire specification reveals no questions that record the time a respondent devotes to unpaid domestic or care work, leisure, or self-care. Per the task instructions, if the instrument only records hours of paid work with no time recorded for any other daily activity, all four statements are false.
